bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 跌破 11月5日低点 $506.7

read.en: Lumentum fell 13.9% on Nov 20 to $460.54, its lowest close since Feb 3, trading $456.13–515.91 after opening at the high. It is below the 5-day ($530.6), 10-day ($570.4), 30-day ($723.1) and 100-day ($826.3), all falling, and the rising 200-day ($816.0). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 2 ($679.26), and RSI is 30.1.
read.zh: Lumentum 11月20日下跌 13.9%，收于 $460.54，为 2月3日以来最低收盘，盘中区间 $456.13–515.91，开盘即为全日高点。股价位于 5 日（$530.6）、10 日（$570.4）、30 日（$723.1）和 100 日均线（$826.3）下方，均在下行，并低于上行的 200 日均线（$816.0）。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图放大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月2日起看空（$679.26），RSI 为 30.1。

read.en: The drop broke all three written supports, $506.7–534.7 (Nov 5, 6, 17 and 19 lows), now resistance. Resistance is $465.5 (Feb 4 close), then $504–508 (Nov 5 low, Feb 5 high) and $516–535 (Nov 20 high, 5-day). Support is $448 (Jan 30 high), then $424.5–435 (Feb 3–5 lows, Feb 3 close) and $400–405. A close above $465.5 would target $504–508; below $448, $424.5–435.

r.en: Nov 5 low $506.69, lost; Feb 5 close $504.42 and high $507.55
